title: 2026 Reunion - Insurance Panel: U.S. Wholesale & Specialty
description:
This year on our Insurance panel at the 2026 Reunion we welcomed members of the U.S. Wholesale & Specialty division to talk about the changes that it has undergone over the last year.

Christian Stobbs, Chief Strategy Officer, moderated the panel of Wendy Houser (President, US Wholesale & Specialty), Mark Schauss (Chief Underwriting Officer), Jamie Carsey (Chief Claims Officer) and Sal Pollaro (Regional President, Northeast).

Learn more about the Reunion at MKLReunion.com
